title: Fix email UTF-8 escapes and add admin notification
description: Fix UTF-8 literal escapes in email templates (raw string literals don't interpret \u escapes) and add admin notification email on athlete inscription.

steps.title: Fix UTF-8 escapes in EmailService email templates
steps.description: The raw string literals ('''/""") in C# do NOT interpret \uXXXX escape sequences — they appear literally in emails. Replace all \u00XX sequences with actual Unicode characters (á, é, í, ó, ú, ¡, ¿, Ñ, etc.) in both HTML and text body templates.

steps.title: Add SendAdminNotificationAsync method to EmailService
steps.description: Add a new method SendAdminNotificationAsync that sends a notification email to the admin email address (SmtpEmailAddress for SMTP, GmailAddress for Gmail). Include athlete data: name, email, phone, sex, category, club, weight. Use a separate HTML template.

steps.title: Update PublicEndpoints.cs to send admin notification
steps.description: In POST /api/athletes, after creating the athlete and sending confirmation email, also send admin notification email. Non-blocking (catch and log errors).

steps.title: Update AthleteEndpoints.cs to send admin notification
steps.description: In POST /api/admin/athletes, after creating the athlete and sending confirmation email, also send admin notification email. Non-blocking (catch and log errors).

steps.title: Build and verify backend compiles
steps.description: Run dotnet build to ensure no compilation errors.
